newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suez sees 1996 net at 800 mln Ffr.
newsitem.headline: Suez sees 1996 net at 800 mln Ffr.

text.p: Cie des Suez said it expected a 1996 net consolidated profit of 800 million francs, against a loss of 3.9 billion francs for 1995, after three billion in charges.
The company said in a statement that it would take a 500 million charge on its holding in Axa-UAP and 2.5 billion francs for the effects of the property crisis.

Suez said it is taking a one billion franc charge on the sale of a four billion franc property loan portfolio to Whitehall Street Real Estate Limited Partnership VII, run by investment bank Goldman Sachs.
Suez said it expected a rise in 1997 pre-tax, pre-exceptional profit after a 25 percent increase in 1996.
